findings.evidence: The whitelist-request MockDB recognized the retired single-JOIN SQL shape but not the production two-query enrichment path
findings.impact: The stale test double produced a false regression signal and stopped the complete Edge suite

findings.evidence: services/edge/package-lock.json resolves hono 4.6.x; npm audit reports GHSA-88fw-hqm2-52qc and related advisories, fixed in 4.12.25
findings.impact: The production Worker has a directly vulnerable framework dependency; exact route applicability still needs code-level confirmation
Any same-origin script injection or compromised asset can exfiltrate a long-lived administrator credential

findings.evidence: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md says v0.5 makes zero network requests and never calls X APIs, while extension/lib/list-sync.ts performs runtime downloads and extension/lib/x-action.ts supports opt-in X requests
findings.impact: Store/privacy messaging can materially misdescribe shipped behavior

findings.evidence: extension/lib/list-sync.ts casts untrusted JSON entries and rules after only checking that they are arrays
findings.impact: A malformed or compromised artifact can poison local state or feed invalid rules into detection

findings.evidence: edge app production build emits one 864.14 kB JavaScript chunk (263.57 kB gzip) and Vite warns above 500 kB
findings.impact: Public landing/list visitors pay for admin and chart code they do not need

findings.evidence: extension/entrypoints/options/App.tsx:554,1182,1209 use placeholder-only inputs without programmatic labels
findings.impact: Screen-reader users cannot reliably identify search, token, and application-note fields

findings.evidence: package versions are root 0.0.1, extension 0.5.0, edge 0.1.0
findings.impact: Release artifacts and diagnostics do not share a single 0.5 identity

findings.evidence: services/edge/wrangler.toml has no observability block and services/edge/src/index.ts contains unstructured console output
findings.impact: Production incidents are harder to query and correlate
